scope: One synthetic64edit complete artifact pair; explicit o200k local packet chooser and two fresh identical-profile native total counts. No tokenizer-model equivalence, fullrequest count, cash, newcodec, scientific validity, longhorizon/fanout/statistical/net-development savings.

implementation.procedure: Inspect optional whole-packet token selection/CLI, exact legacy compatibility and current source-bound recovery.
implementation.acceptance: All eligible candidates complete; rank only budget-fitting packets; full/flags preserved; stable ties; no truncation or authority.

reference_boundary.procedure: Independent roundtrip, compatibility, caps, bad-counter/type/ties/tokenizer-failure and special-token data tests.
reference_boundary.acceptance: Reject invalid callback/counts, bool/negative/noninteger; retain exact source hashes/text/rules; default no tokenizer dependency.

data_integrity.procedure: Freeze actual local-import closure plus external tokenizer/dependency/cache hashes, actual fixture/profile/schema/settings.
data_integrity.acceptance: Exactly2fresh calls, quota<90, no retries/tools/reroute; actual injected settings/catalog/non-task messages identical.

numerical_sanity.procedure: Recompute local complete-packet ranks and actual native input/output/reasoning/cache totals.
numerical_sanity.acceptance: Provider baseline total strictly exceeds candidate; output/reasoning included; cache not subtracted; local encoding never asserted model mapping.

measurement_validity.procedure: Inspect same model/high effort/profile/schema/question/current human/project injection and exact source texts.
measurement_validity.acceptance: Only existing representation selection differs; no omitted content/new format, no crossfixture attribution.

reproducibility.procedure: Separate reviewer verifies frozen implementation/source/tokenizer identity/full recovery/oracle/original provider controls.
reproducibility.acceptance: Current manualnotEngine acceptance usable-with-scope; count selection once, keep all unsuccessful screens.
